review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, repository identity and base commit, exact writable owner scopes, readiness, and required evidence stages agree. The complete HTTPError owner evidence establishes a mutable response property and no existing status getter, supporting the live read-only getter requirement without changing compatibility expectations. The bounded runtime-test excerpt is sufficient for this planning review; it is not treated as complete regression coverage or execution evidence. The proposed type-test path is included by tsconfig.test.json, and the documented test entry distinguishes compilation from AVA runtime execution. Build configuration supports generated distribution artifacts rather than separately maintained declaration edits. Task expectations preserve independent implementation and verification, the verification dependency, and required acceptance coverage. The allowed agents have the relevant active trusted capability claims, including data.change and domain.state, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier; pending-only claims and personas are not used as eligibility evidence. A separate active project reviewer satisfies the supplied review prerequisite without requiring execution capabilities. No material unresolved DEC-001 or hypothetical C input appears in this case, so neither supplies a decision block or human decision. Release fingerprints match between Gold and preview; the documented digest domains and PRD trimming provenance explain the distinct source hashes. Historical preparation placeholders do not override the supplied frozen release inputs. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and provenance, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, new human attestation, or candidate outputs.
